candidate.originalCvMarkdown:
# Curriculum vitae

Target role: Product Requirements Analyst, Collaboration Software Subscriptions

## Experience

- Turned the weekly intake from subscription operations and customer success into user stories for the self-service seat-change and invoice-download pages, each story carrying its acceptance criteria.
- Led acceptance sessions for three billing-page releases with two operations analysts and a customer success manager, logging every criterion as passed or failed.
- Agreed release scope in sprint planning with the engineering manager and the subscription operations lead; scope and the release date were the engineering manager's call.
- Published release notes for the seat-change and invoice-download pages that spelled out one limitation (invoices older than twelve months could not be downloaded) and what the support team needed to take over.
- Two years on the subscription product team covering intake, story writing, acceptance sessions and release notes for the self-service billing pages.

## Work samples

- Work sample: the story set for the invoice-download page with its acceptance criteria, plus the pass/fail log from one acceptance session; ticket identifiers are included so the entries can be traced.
